name: Vandellòs i l'Hospitalet de l'Infant (Spain)
description: A black hoist quarter and a yellow fly charged with two green laurel leaves at the upper hoist and the lower fly of the yellow.
history: The official flag of Vandellòs i l'Hospitalet de l'Infant is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, divided vertically into two parts, the first black of width 1/4 of the length, the second yellow with two laurel leaves; it is the only present flag with the colours of the House of Entença. Approved by the municipal council on 1 March 2006 and published in the DOGC on 22 June 2006.
